description: This file defines functions that generate various JSON response objects for error handling and status reporting in a software system, utilizing the jsoncons library.

methods.name: malFormedRequest
methods.description: Creates a JSON object indicating a malformed request, with variations for different parameters.

methods.name: pathNotFound
methods.description: Generates a JSON response indicating a requested path was not found.

methods.name: noAccess
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating access was denied.

methods.name: valueOutOfBounds
methods.description: Returns a JSON object indicating a value was out of bounds.

methods.name: notSetResponse
methods.description: Prepares a JSON response indicating a value has not been set.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns a current timestamp as a string.

methods.name: addTimeStampToJSON
methods.description: Adds a timestamp to a JSON object as a suffix key.

methods.name: convertJSONTimeStampToISO8601
methods.description: Converts timestamp fields within a JSON object to ISO8601 format.

methods.name: getTimeStampZero
methods.description: Returns a zero or default timestamp string.
